summary: Frontend-only test of static homepage (/inicio.html via /). Ran in Chromium at 1920x1080, 1366x768, 1280x800, 412x915, 390x844 (WebKit engine not available in the tool, so iPhone width was checked in Chromium). All requested checks passed: heading text is 'Concurso da Polícia Militar de Santa Catarina' (shown in uppercase by CSS). The single card [data-testid=concurso-pmsc] is exactly centered: left and right gaps are 712/712 at 1920, 435/435 at 1366 and 392/392 at 1280, with the card 496px wide. On mobile the gaps are 16/16 (card 380px wide at 412, 358px wide at 390). scrollWidth equals the viewport width at every size, so there is no horizontal scroll. The PMSC brasão (/idcap/img/pmsc-logo.png) loads (naturalWidth>0). The title, the edital text and [data-testid=inscricao-data-pmsc] 'Inscrições abertas até 15/11/2026 às 23h59' are all present. Only 1 .ic-card exists, and #lista-concursos has no PMPE/CBMPE/Pernambuco text.

issues: The edital line 'POLÍCIA MILITAR DE SANTA CATARINA - PMSC - Edital 002/CCP/2026 - CFP' is cut off with an ellipsis on one line, so the edital number and '- CFP' are hidden. Consider letting it wrap on mobile.
A faint vertical shadow/gradient strip is visible at the far right edge of the mobile viewport (probably the off-canvas menu's shadow). It is cosmetic only and causes no overflow.
The page never reaches 'networkidle' (Playwright goto with networkidle timed out after 30s), so some script keeps polling or making requests. Not visible to users, but worth checking.

action_items: Optional: allow the edital description to wrap on mobile instead of cutting it off with an ellipsis
Optional: check what keeps network activity going on inicio.html
critical_code_review_comments: The leftover ['pmpe','cbmpe'] href-rewrite script in inicio.html is harmless and still rewrites the /pmpe.html link of the PMSC card (as intended for now).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static page; use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (networkidle never fires). Card centering was measured with getBoundingClientRect on [data-testid=concurso-pmsc]. The Acessar link to /pmpe.html is intentional.
